 Is Dhanush Being Left Out of Anirudh's Wedding?
 According to reports from Chennai media, several actors and actresses from the Tamil film industry have received wedding invitations from Anirudh.
 By:   Priya Chowdhary Nuthalapti   |   5 Nov 2026 1:17 PM IST Share: X Ignoring one hero can make his fans furious. The same is happening in the Tamil industry. Anirudh Ravichander's wedding has become a hot topic in the Tamil film industry. There is a lot of discussion about his wedding and the celebrities who will attend the event. Now a surprising report about actor Dhanush is creating a buzz in Kollywood.
 According to reports from Chennai media, several actors and actresses from the Tamil film industry have received wedding invitations from Anirudh. But Dhanush's name is reportedly missing from the guest list. There is no official confirmation about this news yet.
 Dhanush's name has become a topic of discussion because of his past relationship with the Rajinikanth family. He was married to Rajinikanth's daughter Aishwarya. The couple announced their separation in 2022 and later got divorced.
 This has raised questions about whether Dhanush will attend Anirudh's wedding. Fans are also wondering if Anirudh has really decided not to invite him.
 Anirudh shares a close bond with Superstar Rajinikanth and his family. He also had a strong friendship and professional relationship with Dhanush. In this situation, reports about Dhanush being left out of the wedding have surprised many fans. If everyone from the industry is invited except one hero then it could naturally hurt that actor and his fans.
 However, some fans believe that Dhanush will definitely receive an invitation. They feel that a family celebration connected to Rajinikanth would not be complete without considering Dhanush. At the same time, there is no clarity about the actual wedding guest list.
